systems.finding: AgentHarness' canonical S2=A path lets the parent model decide which continuable child-agent tasks are independent enough to overlap in a shared workspace and later steer or interrupt children when coordination needs change. The reviewed public repository establishes this shared-workspace race boundary, child lifecycle and model-facing control machinery, but publishes no immutable capability result that instantiates the inter-S1 interference and measures attenuation plus the downstream worker outcome through this native path. No direct canonical S2 observation is admitted.

KOT's canonical S2=A path lets the lead choose task dependencies and model-selectable worktree/transactional isolation when concurrent children could interfere in one project workspace. KOT publishes a whole-system FrontierHarness result, but that evaluation does not isolate this native coordination relation or measure an explicit inter-S1 disturbance-to-attenuation outcome. The public product contracts establish the mechanism only for S2 capability purposes, so no direct canonical S2 observation is admitted.

Scion's canonical S2=C path deterministically provisions worktree-per-agent or clone-per-agent isolation to attenuate destructive workspace interference among concurrent project agents. The reviewed public repository documents and implements those isolation modes and Git reconciliation support, but no published result set at the canonical boundary measures an explicit shared-workspace disturbance and its attenuation through the Scion isolation path. No direct canonical S2 observation is admitted.
